g.text: Two fixed evidence packets, multiple constructions; this is a repeated pattern within two tasks.
Dots: three-seed means; whiskers: seed ranges, not confidence intervals. Dashed: previously exposed real-sample reference.
PNS shading: conditional IID row-resampling stability; lipid residual interval unavailable. No equivalence margins.
Eight initial attempts produced no usable table; their failures remain in the complete ledger. Reviews are excluded from independent-construction counts.
